name: Vatsanabha
notes: Highland aconite, and the most dangerous root canon holds. Purified it is a medicine of last resort; unpurified it is what the hill people once tipped arrows with, which is the only recorded use canon has for a poison that was not eventually a cure.
journal_prompt: Hooded blue flowers on a stem in wet upland shade, the root pale and forked like a small hand.
